release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.11 improves postflop BOT bet sizing with GTO-style size selection. It corrects raise sizing in the opponent response model so the call amount is not counted as part of the raise, reducing distorted fold-equity and EV estimates. Routine flop bets and multiway bets use smaller size menus; overbets require strong nut advantage and polar made-hand strength, with only rare low-SPR stack-offs retained. Turn and river can still use larger sizes when the board, ranges, SPR and hand strength support them. Thin one-pair value is more consistently capped. The full 174-scenario preflop policy remains unchanged.
